shell.frame: raw +X end = front (+X), raw -Z side = platform (-Z); no turn, no mirror

doorLeaf.method: clipped at the slab mid-plane z = -0.0155 raw, the clean +Z half kept and mirrored onto -Z (same UVs); the -Z face with the baked figure removed (its atlas region is never sampled)

lod.tool: meshoptimizer simplify by position on the kept half (borders collapse only along themselves: the mid-plane loop stays on the plane), crease-angle normals, planar front UV; base colour / metallic-roughness / normal re-baked from the clean half by an orthographic +Z projection (normals re-expressed in the new tangent frame); then mirrored

doorLeaf.frame: grounded, centred, closing edge (T-handle) at +X, faces +-Z; one leaf of a centre-opening pair (mirror x for the other leaf)

console.method: turned -90 deg about Y (native operator side +Z -> -X), uniform scale
console.frame: grounded, centred; operator side -X, windshield side +X, width along Z
